# ToolHost Catalog

Curated catalog of MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for production use.
Every server is schema-pinned at approval — drift is blocked, not alerted.

## Browse
https://registry.toolhost.online/servers

## Available servers
github-mcp — Full GitHub API (26 tools, OAuth)
brave-search — Web search via Brave API (2 tools, API Key)
stripe — Payments and invoicing (14 tools, API Key)
grafana — Dashboard and metrics queries (8 tools, API Key)
linear — Issues and project management (11 tools, OAuth)
notion — Pages and databases (18 tools, OAuth)
aws-kb-retrieval — AWS Knowledge Base via Bedrock (1 tool, API Key)
playwright — Browser automation (5 tools, None)

## Connect to ToolHost Gateway
https://toolhost.online/start
